calls.reason: SWE-Bench Pro shows frequent failures on complex tasks, but does not measure a sustained engineering job. The packet also lacks evidence establishing excessive costs.
Chroma documents context degradation and METR finds limited long-task reliability. Neither establishes the broader inability to maintain software or the claimed inability to learn and adapt.
Anthropic’s funding disclosure and Uber’s annual report do not establish comparable spending totals. The calculation mixes financing and estimated infrastructure costs without a reconciliation.

Trillo’s music video and the Critterz remake demonstrate useful Sora production work. Their workflow accounts leave unclear whether Sora substituted for substantive acting or animation responsibilities.
The packet contains no independent Copilot GPU utilization measurement. The 60% figure rests solely on Zitron’s anonymous sources.
